design.direction: Mean last three observed displacements, norm strictly greater than 0.03 m.
design.cue: Mean last 3 observed speeds / mean first 4 (floor 0.1 m/s) <= 0.85.
design.truth: Frozen replay fast_deceleration: deceleration or stop, using future only to label.
design.intervals: 2000 paired bootstrap draws using 15-row blocks; seeds averaged within window.
design.scope: Exploratory reanalysis on already examined ETH and ZARA01.
